svg.aria-label: The parts of Officium. Boxes: Library folder: rituals/ or examples/rituals/ (files outside the code); Browser build: Node server, src/lib/server/ (part of Officium); Desktop build: Tauri, src-tauri/src/library.rs (part of Officium); Oculus build: file bridge, src/lib/oculus/ (part of Officium); Data layer: parse and validate, src/lib/data/ (part of Officium); Reader functions: src/lib/reader/ (part of Officium); Views: src/lib/views/Reader.svelte (part of Officium).
